envelope.description: Open saved connections on demand instead of at boot

body.title: Open saved connections on demand instead of at boot
body.summary: Remove the boot loop, make the main-thread management handlers open a repository on first use, have fresh initialization take its ticket key before its first disk write, and carry a keystore failure's cause to managementRejection.
acceptanceChecks: A daemon start reads nothing from the Keychain and opens its socket
The first management request opens a repository and a later one does not reopen it
A refused Keychain read reports secret-unavailable and the next request retries
A refused first-time set-up leaves nothing on disk
A plain listing of an unmanaged repository creates no state and reads no secret
Shutdown still closes every root opened on demand
